sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,C.S.C.,Vivek Kumar Singh
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.
Heard Shri N.K. Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Addl.
Solicitor General of India assisted by Shri Vivek Kumar Singh, learned counsel for respondents no. 1 to 4 and Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Addl.

Chief Standing Counsel appearing for respondents no. 5 & 6.
2.
The grievances urged in the instant petition are two fold.

Firstly that the respondents have not paid compensation as per market value to the petitioner for acquisition of his plot bearing Gata Nos.
4958 and 4959 and second that the respondents have taken possession of certain area in excess of Radhey Lal Yadav vs Union Of India And 5 Others on 7 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125113571/
1 the area notified for acquisition.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned Addl. Solicitor General of India points out that an award has already been made in respect of the acquired land on 24 April 2023, a copy of the same is taken on record.
Learned counsel for the respondents has also been served copy of the award in the Court.

In case, the petitioner is aggrieved by the award, it is open to him to seek enhancement of compensation by getting the dispute referred to the Arbitrator as provided under Section 20-F(6) of the Railways Act,
1989.
4.

In respect of second grievance, we are of the opinion that respondent no. 6 should get the site inspected by a Revenue Team to find out whether the remaining area of the petitioner's land is still available on the spot or not.
Thereafter, the matter should be placed before the Committee constituted under Government Order dated 12.05.2016 for ascertaining whether possession of any excess land has been taken.
If it comes to the conclusion that possession of any excess land has been taken over by the Railways, the compensation payable shall be determined and paid.

5. Accordingly, the petitioner is permitted to approach respondent no. 6 with a fresh representation along with true attested copy of the instant order in regard to his claim relating to compensation for the excess land allegedly taken over by the respondents.
The said representation as directed above will be decided in accordance with law after getting the site inspected and demarcated by a Survey Team.
6. The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
7. The amendment application and other pending applications stand disposed of in terms of the instant order.
(Donadi Ramesh,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.) Order Date :- 7.8.2023
Mukesh Kr.
